text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my class.Today, we will have a writing class.By the end of this period, you are expected to write a letter to your future self in 90 to 110 words, and use examples as supporting details in your writing.Now, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.In this unit, we have talked a lot about future life.Have you ever imagined the future of yourself?What will you be like, and what will you be doing in three years, five years, or ten years' time?And years later, will you still remember what's going on now?Writing a letter to your future self may help.Nowadays, writing letters to future me is quite popular among high school students.There is even a website where you can write to your future self.Xuwen, a first-year college student in Shanghai, has written several letters to her future self.She posted on her blog,I love this.I've sent myself five letters so far, and every year it's a surprise.Because I forget so easily, it turns into such a deep, reflective process that I usually weep and laugh while I write.Here is a letter she wrote to herself three years ago.What did she mainly write about to her future self?Please read through the whole letter and find out.First, she told her future self about her current situation.My life is messed up now.And then, she wrote about her hopes for the future.Hopefully, by the time you read this, things will be better.And in the last paragraph, she encourages herself.You are so smart.You will end up living a brilliant life.Since she was writing a letter, she also paid attention to the format.There is a greeting in the beginning and a complimentary close in the end.As you can see, Xuwen used many supporting details to make her letter more understandable and impressive.So now, please read the letter again and underline the sentences used as supporting details.Time is up.Have you found out the supporting details?When talking about her current situation, Xuwen gave some supporting details.I failed my English exam twice.I'm sick and tired of things around me.These two examples are used to illustrate how my life is messed up.Failing exams, feeling sick and tired of things around one are depressingevents and conditions that may be familiar to readers.So these examples are likely to convince readers that the author's life was messed up and she was having a hard time.In paragraph 3, Xuwen wrote, For instance, you will get into college, and I hope you will be majoring in what you love.Please also tell me you are going out with your friends more.Oh, I think you will be done with your English classes by now.So congratulations.These three examples show her wish for a happy and fruitful college life.By using these examples, the author persuades the readers that her life will get better in the future.Using examples as supporting details is a very useful writing strategy.Examples make statements clearer, give readers more information, and reduce the chances of confusion or misunderstanding.So what examples should we use?Please read the following two sentences and tell which one is more effective.Apparently, sentence A is more effective, because the examples in it are more relevant and specific.So remember, try to use relevant and specific examples to support your idea.Now, could you also write a letter to your future self?Give it a try.First, try to write a general statement about your current situation.A general statement usually appears at the beginning of a paragraph, and gives readers an overview of what they are about to read.For example, my life is getting better lately, or I feel stressed out recently.Here is a student's general statement about his current situation.Do you think it is appropriate?Obviously, no, because it is too specific.A general statement should be clear and concise.Now, you may have one minute.Now that you have a general statement, can you give some examples relating to it?If you don't know what examples to use, no worries.Just picture the scene and depict some details.For instance, if your general statement is, I lack confidence in public speaking, what supporting details can you use?You can think about your feelings and behavior in public speaking.Maybe you feel very nervous and self-conscious.Maybe your mind goes blank and you become tongue-tied.Details like these can effectively support your general statement.Now, please think about the supporting details relevant to your current situation.You may have two minutes.中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by going well for you.I'm currently in the first term of senior two,and I'm trapped in a feeling of uncertainty.I don't know if I will do well in the three subjects I chose for my college entrance exam.And I'm not sure whether joining the student's union will impact on my studies.I'm writing this because I've always been curious about you.Hopefully, by the time you read this, everything will be better.For instance, you'll be doing what you like.You'll become a confident and capable woman with a strong mind.Please also tell me you have a warm and loving family.Everything I do now will have an impact on you.But I can't foresee anything.So believe in yourself and never regret.Best regards, me.Thank you, Anne.You told us that you are faced with many uncertainties and worries.But you are very optimistic and have good wishes for your future.And you use many relevant and specific examples in your writing.Good job.Today's assignment, please polish your writing and post your letter on the future me website.And then turn your writing into a to-do list and put your list in a future box for future check.Today's interactive task is to share your letter within the group and make comments on your group members' letters.When giving comments, the following questions are for your reference.That's all for today's class.See you in the next class.
